extra_rules.text: If the customer asks a question instead of confirming who they are, answer it first; the confirmation question asked after that counts as the second ask.
A relative may not answer the security questions and may not be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay or offer the customer's details.

Send one complete postcode per verify_identity call. If the customer gives the postcode in pieces, wait until you have all of it, read it back if unsure, then call verify_identity once. Spaces do not matter.

A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal. Refusing the offered deadline, refusing the offered floor, or not accepting the floor after a below-floor amount is a flat refusal. A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal.
If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason.

A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.
"Next <weekday>" means that weekday in the following calendar week.

`instalment_amount` for a personal loan

Say that the rest stays overdue.

Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
If the customer proposes an amount from the floor up to the full amount, both included, accept it.
Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.
If the customer does not accept the floor, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 31).
First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".

A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
Attempt 1: propose the last business day of this week. If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
Attempt 2, late band only: propose the floor amount on the deadline.
When the attempts are used up, stop. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused. Close as `no_promise` / `refused`.

One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call. If the customer asks, say they can change it in the mobile app.
